title: Mommy Needs Things Too
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Six
verse: "Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself."

pages.text:
The list was long and every line belonged to someone small:
new shoes for Pip, a book for Jojo, socks and snacks and all.

And Baby Bee had grown a size. And Biscuit's bowl was bare.
But Mommy's name was nowhere on that list. It wasn't there.

Her shoes had holes. Her coat was thin. Her comb had lost a tooth.
She'd gone without so long that she'd forgotten it's the truth.

At the store, asked Jojo, "Mom, what are YOU getting, though?"
And Mommy said, "Oh, nothing. I don't need a thing, you know."

But Pip looked at her worn-out shoes, then Pip looked at her own.
"Mom, yours have holes," said Pip, "way bigger than I've grown."

Then Jojo said the thing that made her stop right in the aisle:
"Mom, you buy us everything. Do you get stuff, sometime? Once in a while?"

And Mommy stood there holding all the things for everyone,
and wondered when she'd learned to act as if she needed none.

She knelt right down. "You're right," she said. "I've something to admit:
I give and give and give to you, and leave myself no bit.

I thought that loving you meant I must always go without.
But you are always watching me. And that's what this is about.

If I say Mommy doesn't count, then someday you might say
that YOU don't count, and you don't ask, and needs just go away.

But you count. And I count. And a family is a place
where everybody's needing gets a seat, and gets a space.

So Mommy put some shoes that fit inside the cart that day.
And Jojo cheered. And Pip clapped hard. And Baby Bee said, "YAY!"

And Biscuit wagged. And on the way, the list at last was true —
with something there for each of them, and one for Mommy, too.

Because your Mommy gives and gives the whole day, through and through —
and Mommy needs things sometimes, too… because she's human too.

verses: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you?
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
Her children arise up, and call her blessed.
